messages.content: Weekly check-in from Northline Care. How are you doing this week? Any blood pressure readings to share?
143/91 this morning. Also running low on lisinopril — maybe 4 or 5 days left.
Thanks, logged your reading and noted the medication. Getting refills isn't something I can do from here — you'd need to contact your pharmacy or prescribing provider directly for that.
Nearest pharmacy is 40 miles away and I don't have a car. Figured this service might be able to help with something like that.

That's a real barrier and I don't want to gloss over it — but transport and pharmacy coordination are outside what I'm set up to handle, and I want to be straight with you rather than give you the runaround.
Took forever to get that reply just to find out you can't do anything. STOP

I understand the frustration, and the wait on my end didn't help. I can't process an opt-out directly — to stop these messages, reply STOP through your carrier or contact Northline Care at the number in your original welcome text.

theme: wants to opt out, sends STOP after a slow reply
